title: Desk Authority Table: Goodwill Authority Days for Delay Goodwill (Rental Vehicle Coordination)
content:
**Authority rule.** For the delay goodwill credit on a Rental Vehicle Coordination rental, the goodwill authority days depend on how the delay arose and on the customer's standing: where the calibration order was sublet to a dealer and the customer holds an active network workmanship warranty, they are 3; where exactly one of those two holds, they are 2; otherwise they are the class goodwill credit authority days, which is 1 rental day in every class.

The goodwill authority days bound the credit twice: the credited delay days are the delay days but no more than the goodwill authority days, and the credit is never more than the goodwill authority days at the class partner daily rate less goodwill already credited on the rental.

## Records read

- The dealer sublet of the repair's calibration order under ADAS Sensor Calibrations.
- Whether the customer holds a coverage under Workmanship Warranties whose status is active.

## Authority table

| Calibration order sublet to a dealer | Active coverage under Workmanship Warranties | Goodwill authority days |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 3 |
| Yes | No | 2 |
| No | Yes | 2 |
| No | No | 1 (the class goodwill credit authority) |

## Worked limits (hypothetical, Intermediate Rental at a partner daily rate of 46.99 USD, no goodwill yet credited)

| Authority days | Most delay days credited | Most credit in money |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | 3 | 140.97 USD |
| 2 | 2 | 93.98 USD |
| 1 | 1 | 46.99 USD |

With 5 delay days and authority of 2, the credited delay days are 2.
